items.title: Kindling, Catalyst, and Containment: Will the West Bank Ignite?
items.summary:
As violence by Israeli settlers against Palestinians in the West Bank has escalated, often with the acquiescence or support of Israel’s military, and the Israeli government has increasingly constricted Palestinian daily life, the potential for a new intifada — or uprising — has intensified.
